column2: the planned section-scoped conditional detector closes `#### split-path (decomposition panel)` only at the next equal-or-shallower markdown heading. in `skills/design/skill.md`, that next heading is `### external reviewer setup` (line 385), with no intervening `## step 3`. step 3 prose at `<!-- step:3 — plan review -->` (line 366) and the eager `plan-review.md` mandatory read at line 382 therefore sit inside the open split-path scope. with no other eager directive for `plan-review.md`, eager-wins dedup cannot recover it; the file moves from eager to conditional-only. that drops roughly 215 lines / ~6k tokens below the issue acceptance target while a regenerated baseline can still look self-consistent. planned isolated fixtures and byte-equality baseline checks do not exercise this split-path-then-step-3 layout, so the regression would not be caught.
